metric: Share of faulty query variants (mutants, 14 operators) that targeted databases plus corner cases tell apart from the original, among mutants not proven equivalent; the engine's default 8 random databases get 46.3% dev, 10.4% held out, one random seed 11.2% / 4.4%.
correctness: Every kill repeats on both sides on a database respecting NOT NULL and keys (foreign keys not modelled); no kill is counted from a side that disagrees with itself. Survivors not proven equivalent stay in the denominator.
held_out: 62.8% (1,244/1,981 mutants of 22 TPC-H and 19 TPC-C queries), run once after the strategies were fixed on the development split
caveats: Originals: Calcite, Spark, a 16-query university set (dev) and TPC-H, TPC-C (held out); 72 originals are unsupported (DuckDB rejects them) and not counted. Mutants are generated, not hand-labelled; 'proven' = proven equivalent mutants (excluded from the score), 'refuted' = killed by any strategy, 'unknown' = survived and not proven equivalent (many are DISTINCT toggles that are equivalent but unprovable), 'timeout' = TPC-H queries over the 90 s per-query budget, 'error' = invalid mutants. Strategy details were tuned on the development split. Median counterexample is 3 rows (random 8 databases: 38).
